observation.observed_probe_delta: Current main added an offline observation-first/intervention probe. Observation mode performs no hidden-state modification; intervention mode requires the canonical atomic experiment lease and emits clean/corrupted/target/sham/off-target evidence plus a technical clean off-target reference.
observation.probe_self_limit: The raw probe explicitly records loader_consumption_attestation=false and promotion.status=UNASSESSED_CANDIDATE_ONLY, because post-load parameter values are not exact loader-consumption evidence and no predeclared causal acceptance thresholds are evaluated.
observation.gap: Without a dedicated fail-closed validator, a downstream consumer could accidentally treat the raw intervention-shaped envelope or derived local IDs as stronger causal/canonical evidence than the probe itself claims.

hypothesis: A machine-checkable raw-probe evidence fence will prevent accidental J-Space causal-credit laundering while preserving the observation-first executable path.
counterhypothesis: The probe's narrative promotion field and zero-credit fields are sufficient without an independent validator.
discriminator: Validate both observation and intervention envelopes and poison the envelope with network touches, loader self-attestation, credit inflation, causal promotion, hidden-state modification in observation mode, missing control family, wrong target patch binding and missing intervention lease.

behavior: forces all product/HCU/J-Space/training credits to zero
observation mode requires a single unmodified named-activation observation with no intervention metrics
intervention mode requires validated atomic lease plus exact five core conditions and one technical off-target clean reference
target patch must bind to clean activation; sham must bind to corrupted activation; off-target patch must bind to its clean reference
derived local model-execution and J-Space trace IDs may not claim canonical identity

tests.deterministic_local_sanity: 10/10 PASS in the ChatGPT tool container

external_solution_harvest.nnsight: Current NNsight documentation describes model.trace as a single forward-pass context that permits reading and modifying intermediate activations; local PyTorch models are supported.
external_solution_harvest.transformerlens: Current TransformerLens activation-patching documentation uses clean/corrupted runs, replacement of a corrupted activation with the clean activation, and an output metric to measure the counterfactual effect.
external_solution_harvest.adoption: Only the causal-control principle is adopted; no external hosted inference/provider path was used.
